concerns.text: The primary outcome variable (UPDRS III scores) is declared missing in the verified PPMI datasets (see research.md) yet the plan proceeds to compute per‑patient UPDRS III slopes and to validate taxon‑slope associations against them. Without a source for UPDRS III the validation target is undefined, making the core hypothesis untestable. The plan must either secure a verified source for longitudinal UPDRS III data or redesign the analysis to use an available proxy outcome.
